newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar called to open 0.10 cent firmer.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar called to open 0.10 cent firmer.

text.p: CSCE world sugar was called to open 0.10 cent firmer Tuesday as traders expect the market to follow through on Monday's strong finish.

Monday, fund buying drove New York raws to five-weeks. The benchmark July contract closed 0.17 cent higher at 11.34 cents a lb after trading from 11.13 to 11.35 cents. October settled up 0.19 at 11.19 after hitting a life-of-contract high of 11.20 cents. Deferreds ended 0.14 to 0.08 cent higher.
An estimated 25,649 lots changed hands on the day.
Technically, traders pegged key chart resistance at 11.50 cents for July delivery.

In London, white sugar futures rallied early Tuesday, bolstered by commodity fund buying. At 0851 EDT/1251 GMT, LIFFE spot August contract was up $1.70 at $329.50, and the rest of the board was $1.40 to $2.20 higher.
